subject.title: Add support for Kimi K3 model

question: Should OpenClaw expose unqualified `kimi-k3` or `kimi/k3` aliases in addition to the provider-qualified Moonshot model reference?
rationale: Current `main` provides the model through the existing Moonshot provider boundary, while the requested aliases could overlap with the separately documented Kimi Coding endpoint and create a competing routing convention.

options.title: Keep provider-qualified refs
options.body: Treat `moonshot/kimi-k3` as the canonical selection path and avoid ambiguous global aliases across the two Kimi endpoints.

options.title: Define explicit aliases
options.body: Add aliases only after documenting which provider and endpoint each alias selects and covering that routing contract with focused tests.

recommendation.title: Keep provider-qualified refs
recommendation.body: Treat `moonshot/kimi-k3` as the canonical selection path and avoid ambiguous global aliases across the two Kimi endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Moonshot provider boundary whose routing contract would be affected by shorthand aliases.
